summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to a $4.7 million promissory note held by related party FAVO Holdings, LLC, extending the $1.6 million final installment maturity from September 1 to October 15, 2026, with $20,000 interest at 10% and a temporary waiver of the 15% default rate through the extended date. CEO Shaun Quin recused himself; disinterested directors approved. This is a routine debt-amendment credit event, not a special situation; risk-arb focus is limited to the near-term October 15 payment deadline.
